method: Exposure ranking on the time-ordered patient-flow graph (P1) over real ESBL E. coli and MRSA source episodes of the scoring period, pooled by within-event Mann-Whitney pairs against 1,000 label-permutation rewirings; E1 and E2 as descriptions; flow-partner (B1, positive) and uniform-partner (B2, negative) injected two-unit clusters as controls
notes: metrics.P1 is the pooled version-A test, harness outcome (Poisson upper tail, alpha 0.05 and 0.001), over the source episodes of the plan's rule with onset in 2024-10-01 to 2026-09-27 and 56 days of data after it; a pooled AUC at alpha 0.001 rests on the events with a positive unit. Intervals are 95 % bootstrap over events (1,000 resamples, seed 2026), an addition of the run; the rewiring null band and p-values are in P1_variants. One planted event (P1_planted) is a description, not a claim. P1_controls are controls, not evidence about flow: B1 draws its partner by the flows exposure reads, B2 is independent of flow. Injection seed 2026 only.
